correctness.rationale: For connected simple base graph order n>=3, a connected dominating set of a full edge subdivision induces a connected vertex cover S, selected interior subdivision vertices must form a spanning tree T of G[S], and each excluded original x needs exactly one selected incident subdivision neighbor. Inclusion-minimality further forces every tree leaf to have an outside-S neighbor. All selected vertices are indispensable under those conditions. Weighted matrix-tree theorem and Prüfer-word surjection count give the K_{a,b} Stirling polynomial; n+|S|-1 verifies degrees and K_{2,b} gap. Independent verification: Independently built full-edge-subdivided K_{2,2}, K_{2,3}, K_{2,4} and brute-enumerated all connected inclusion-minimal dominating sets. Obtained labeled count polynomials {6:8}, {7:12,8:6}, {8:32,10:8}, exactly the specialized Stirling formula. Inspected the full standalone verifier; finite cases only corroborate the general leaf/tree proof.
